title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Cowork is now a server-side agent runtime — remote sessions + scheduled tasks run with no device online
bullets.summary: Anthropic's Cowork rollout put sessions, files, and Projects in the cloud with background work and scheduled tasks that fire with nothing on the user's machine — this Industry Pulse run is one of them.
bullets.how: This is the substrate The Construct's fleet already runs on; lean into server-side scheduled tasks for Lens, Pulse, Mallard, and the visibility scans instead of anything that assumes a laptop is awake.

bullets.title: Skills 2.0 role library — Anthropic ships pre-built, executable Skill packs across 11 knowledge-work roles
bullets.summary: Skills are now full workflow packages with executable scripts and an official multi-role library (sales, legal, finance, data, etc.), not loose prompts.
bullets.how: Direct competitive read for our installed-skills registry: benchmark Construct operator skills against Anthropic's role packs, adopt the executable-script pattern, and keep the daily/weekly new-skills scan pointed at this library as the moving baseline.

bullets.title: Runway ships an MCP server — image/video generation callable from inside any agent, no context switch
bullets.summary: Runway MCP lets an agent generate polished images and video in-workflow; it joins AVCLabs and a widening set of media-generation MCPs.
bullets.how: A native path for Brand 9 Signs signage mockups and PRAGMA operator creative to be produced by an agent rather than a human in a separate tool; wire a media-gen MCP behind a Construct creative operator alongside the Higgsfield browser path.

bullets.title: Frontier ships like patches — Meta Muse Spark 1.2 (Aug 5) and DeepSeek V4-Flash (Jul 31) now beating its own V4-Pro on agent/coding tasks at no price change
bullets.summary: The newest weights are incremental fast-follows: Meta's Muse Spark image/video line and a DeepSeek Flash tier that out-agents the larger Pro model with no cost bump.
bullets.how: DeepSeek V4-Flash is a cheap agentic-inference candidate for high-volume Construct jobs; keep the cost/quality routing split and pre-wire the eval harness so a Flash-class model can be swapped in the day it clears our bar.

bullets.title: arXiv — 'Context Engineering: From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture' frames context as the agent's operating system
bullets.summary: Proposes five context-quality criteria (relevance, sufficiency, isolation, economy, provenance) and treats the informational environment, not the prompt, as the design surface for multi-agent systems.
bullets.how: A governance rubric for the swarm: score every operator's context payload on those five criteria, and use 'isolation' + 'provenance' as the guardrail language PRAGMA sells that platform players don't.

praxis_lesson: The value keeps migrating up-stack — weights and even media generation are commoditizing into patch-cadence releases and callable MCPs, while the durable surface is the runtime and the context discipline around it. The Construct's edge isn't owning a model or a generator; it's running governed, well-contexted operators on the server-side Cowork runtime and packaging that discipline (isolation, provenance, scanned skills) as the product.
